description:
Create a new product in the Drupal Commerce store with the following details:

- Title: 'Organic Bamboo Wireless Charger'
- SKU: 'OBW-CHR-01'
- Price: $39.99 USD
- Description: Write a meaningful product description that highlights the product's eco-friendly bamboo construction and Qi-compatible wireless charging capability.

Note: In Drupal Commerce, the SKU and price are set on a 'product variation', not on the product itself. After creating the product, you will need to add a product variation with the specified SKU and price.

The product must be published (not left in draft) for this task to succeed.
